## What's new

### Appearance settings

Open the settings, then **Appearance**. A preview shows each change as you make it. A dimmed
option has no effect with the current settings.

![The Tiles options](https://github.com/CVasilakis/luncher/raw/v0.2.0/.github/release-notes/v0.2.0/tiles.png)

**Tiles**

- **Vertical alignment:** the rows of apps at the top, the center or the bottom of the screen.
- **Horizontal alignment:** the row that isn't full at the left, the center or the right.
- **Full bottom row:** keeps the bottom row full, with the shorter row above the others. Only
  with the rows centered or at the bottom.
- **Corner radius:** from square (0 dp) to 32 dp, or Pill for fully round ends.

![The Status bar options](https://github.com/CVasilakis/luncher/raw/v0.2.0/.github/release-notes/v0.2.0/status-bar.png)

**Status bar**

- **Time** and **Date:** shown or hidden.
- **Side:** the time and the date on the left or the right, the settings gear on the other side.
- **Order:** the time or the date first. Only when both are shown.

### A new default look

The apps now start at the bottom of the screen, centered, with rounded corners.

### Apps show up right away

Apps you install, update or remove, and apps you hide or show in **Hide apps**, now show up on
the home screen at once.
